# EchelonFox

> EchelonFox provides commercial growth strategy and implementation for established companies. It works with leaders of proven companies, typically 10–30 people, whose growth has become fragmented: it identifies the commercial constraint that matters most, then connects positioning, customer acquisition, sales processes, and technology into a clearer way to grow.

## About

EchelonFox is led by founder Abe Quinn, who reads how a business makes money, finds the constraint holding growth back, designs a better commercial system, and leads the work to build it. His background includes enterprise B2B sales, founding a startup acquired by Staples, and operations and kitchen experience. He is an American based in Finland, working with U.S. businesses.

Engagements follow four stages: Diagnose → Design → Build → Improve. Websites, SEO, campaigns, CRM workflows, and AI tools are parts of a solution, chosen after the commercial problem is diagnosed.

- [About](https://echelonfox.com/about): How Abe reads a business, finds the constraint, and leads the build.
- [Contact](https://echelonfox.com/contact): Send a message or book a call.

## Services

- [Commercial diagnosis and positioning](https://echelonfox.com/services/commercial-diagnosis): Sales and customer analysis, segmentation, positioning, and measurement.
- [Customer acquisition and conversion](https://echelonfox.com/services/customer-acquisition): Websites, search, local visibility, Google Shopping, and paid media. Website projects are flat-rate from $1,000.
- [Sales process, CRM, and follow-up](https://echelonfox.com/services/sales-process-crm): CRM setup, pipeline design, and lifecycle email and SMS.
- [Practical AI and automation](https://echelonfox.com/services/ai-automation): Lead response, scheduling, CRM workflows, follow-up, and admin automation, with human handoff.

## Work, Pricing & Insights

- [Work](https://echelonfox.com/work): Case studies in the format asked for → broader issue found → what was built → outcome where evidence exists.
- [Pricing](https://echelonfox.com/pricing): Flat monthly plans starting at $1,500/mo, 60 days' notice to cancel. Advertising spend is billed separately by the ad platforms.
- [Insights](https://echelonfox.com/insights): Practical guides on local SEO, AI search, and growth.
